source.method: Read-only original Figma Plugin API. Matrices are flat row-major[a,b,tx,c,d,ty]. RGBA colors are original unconverted DisplayP3 floats. No Figma nodes were changed.

legacy.interpretation: Legacy and modern values differ only by source floating-point precision, maximum5.960464477539063e-8; the four mask types, child counts, paint types/order, opacity, blend mode and backing fills agree. Do not substitute Theme colors: original legacy palette is explicitly retained above.

hero.reason: Original hero is a single iris solid vector at opacity0.6 behind a linear luminance mask. It is not an application of any of the four procedural pattern families.

header.reason: No pattern family instances or editable-pattern descendants in original header variants.
